correctness.rationale: Every product face measure factors and gives an exact codimension-two coefficient. The planar factors have area >=4 and perimeter >=8 by the verified published source, while a triangular factor has perimeter >=6sqrt(3) by tangent-line Jensen. Coefficientwise monotonicity yields the displayed remainder and each triangular deficit is compensated for dimension >=3. Cubical equality follows from the unique tangent quadrilateral perimeter minimizer. An inradius-one equilateral triangular prism realizes the uniform sharp gap. Finite checks replayed but are not infinite proofs.
